description: This Java class defines an Android Activity named DoneButtonActivity. It demonstrates a custom 'Done' button integrated into the action bar, which finishes the activity when clicked. The class inflates a custom view for the action bar, sets display options, handles menu creation, and responds to menu item selections to provide cancel functionality.

classes.name: DoneButtonActivity
classes.description: Main activity class demonstrating custom action bar with a 'Done' button and cancel menu option.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, inflates custom action bar view with a 'Done' button that finishes the activity when clicked, and sets the main content view.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu with cancel option.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item clicks; if 'cancel' is selected, finishes the activity.
